description: Instructions for content operations commands from specialized tabs (Review, Design, Draw)

InsertNewComment.apply: Add a comment with text 'Test comment.' on the word 'TARGET'.
InsertNewComment.reply: Add a reply 'This is a reply.' to the existing comment on 'TARGET' as user2.

ReviewDeleteComment.apply: Delete the comment on the text 'TARGET'.

ReviewDeleteAllCommentsInDocument.apply: Delete all comments in the document.

ReviewDeleteAllCommentsShown.apply: Delete all shown comments in the document.

DeleteAllResolvedComments.apply: Delete all resolved comments in the document.

AcceptAllChangesInDocAndStopTracking.apply: Accept all tracked changes in the document and stop tracking changes.

RejectAllChangesInDocAndStopTracking.apply: Reject all tracked changes in the document and stop tracking changes.

InsertInkDrawingCanvas.apply: Insert an ink drawing canvas (432x252 points) after the word 'TARGET'.

ReviewTrackChanges.apply: Enable track changes in the document and append ' TRACKED_EDIT' to the end of the text.

WatermarkRemove.apply: Remove the watermark from the document.
